why: MZZ is a named, manualized early-mathematics training programme rather than a general instructional element.
name: MZZ training program "Mengen, zählen, Zahlen"
product_description: A German small-group preschool training programme developed by Krajewski, Nieding, and Schneider that builds quantity, counting, number, and numerical-relation knowledge through structured, playful sessions using concrete materials.

why: The QuILT is a named, topic-specific instructional tutorial and simulation package rather than a reusable instructional element or a general course design.
name: Quantum Interactive Learning Tutorial (QuILT) on a Mach-Zehnder Interferometer with single photons
product_description: A research-based guided quantum-mechanics tutorial developed by Singh and colleagues that combines thought experiments, background material, and an interactive computer simulation for learning single-photon Mach–Zehnder interferometry.
